colour-blend.reason: Start colours (the /color records only) from blended vertex colours: alpha, and any channel whose weights come from a loop-mode edge position, differs by 1/255 in some particles (each value within 1); red, green and blue of every random draw match. Positions, directions, rotations and seeds are in the strictly compared records.

lines-topology.reason: A mesh of lines: Unity reads its index buffer as triangles and emits from the result (a degenerate first triangle and one past the index data), warning that the mesh is not valid; Unbound gives the same warning and emits at the shape's origin, as Unity does for point and empty meshes.

spread-boundary.reason: Edge Loop and Ping-Pong with spread 0.25: the rate particles born at exactly 0.25 s and 1.25 s snap to the next spread step in Unity and to the one before in Unbound (their birth time is just under the boundary there); every other particle matches.
